Laura (Sales): Need a hosted API key for Acme POC — dev env only. Requirements: demo key (short-lived), CI key (longer, rotated), IP allowlist to customer CIDR. Who can create + provide rotation plan? cc @Devon
Devon (Solutions): I can take this. Quick question: ephemeral (24h) for demos, and a 7d rotating key for CI sound right? Also do we need specific scopes (e.g., embeddings vs. generation)?
Laura (Sales): yes — generation + streaming for demo, full gen + embeddings for CI. They want rotation automated and revoke at POC end.
Devon (Solutions): Plan: create two hosted keys. demo_key: ttl=24h, scopes=[generate,streaming]; ci_key: ttl=7d, scopes=[generate,embeddings], cron rotate daily. Apply IP allowlist 203.0.113.0/24 as requested. Store secrets in customer-approved vault (KMS). Revoke on completion. Ops to run creation.
ops-bot: Creating demo_key now...
ops-bot: ```
/create-hosted-key --name demo_key --ttl 86400 --scopes generate,streaming --allowlist 203.0.113.0/24
Result: key_id=hk_demo_9f2
Secret delivered via secure DM to @Laura (Sales) and @Devon (Solutions)
```
Max (Infra): For the CI key I'll wire up rotation automation. Use this script as a starter (run from infra runner with admin creds stored in Vault):
Max (Infra): ```bash
# rotate hosted key daily at 02:00 UTC
0 2 * * * curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/rotate -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"key_id":"hk_ci_7b3"}'
```
Max (Infra): Note: $ADMIN_TOKEN must be in HashiCorp Vault and the runner must have least-privilege IAM.
Ava (Security): A couple policy notes: 1) All hosted keys for POCs must be recorded in the SQA tracker with scope + TTL. 2) Secrets persisted only in KMS-backed vault. 3) Rotation window for CI = 7d is acceptable; prefer 48h for higher-risk customers. 4) Audit logging must be enabled (retention 30d).
Laura (Sales): Good call. For this customer 7d is OK. I'll add the SQA entries.
Devon (Solutions): Steps Laura can paste into SOW/handbook:
1) Request hosted keys via sales/solutions thread.
2) Approve scopes and allowlist CIDR.
3) Infra/ops create keys and deliver secrets via secure DM or approved vault.
4) Configure cron-based rotation (example script provided).
5) Revoke keys at POC end and record in SQA.
Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted-keys#ephemeral (link to internal guide).
Laura (Sales): Perfect — copying into SOW. Who's owning CI_key creation?
Devon (Solutions): I'll own CI_key provisioning and handoff. ETA: EOD today.
ops-bot: demo_key created and delivered. Will mark thread when CI_key done. :white_check_mark:
Laura (Sales): Thanks team — I'll notify customer once CI key is ready and include rotation notes in the onboarding checklist.
Devon (Solutions): On it, will post proof of delivery here when done. :thumbsup:
